name: TIDAL
description: Browse your TIDAL collection and personalized mixes, search for music, and play supported streams in Kalinka Player. Sign in with your TIDAL account; playback requires a subscription. Uses the unofficial tidalapi client and is not made or endorsed by TIDAL.

notes: Requires Kalinka Player server 5.9.1 or newer (below 6), plugin SDK 3.11 or newer (below 4), and Python 3.11 or newer.
Sign in with a TIDAL account using the browser link in plugin settings or module status. Playback requires a TIDAL streaming subscription; availability depends on the account and region.

Automatically requests CD-quality lossless audio and supports direct unencrypted FLAC and MP3 streams. TIDAL Max / hi-res, segmented DASH, encrypted streams and AAC/MP4 playback are unsupported. TIDAL collections are read-only.

The architecture-independent DEB is built and tested on Debian 13 and Ubuntu 24.04 for ARM64 and amd64. A compatible Debian-packaged Kalinka Player server and resolvable Python dependencies are required.
This integration uses the unofficial tidalapi client. Automated tests use fake API responses; live account sign-in and playback remain unverified.
To change accounts, enable Forget TIDAL account on next restart in plugin settings, apply and restart, then follow the sign-in link. The switch resets automatically.
